# Quote

**Name:** `core/quote`
**Category:** [text](/block-editor/reference-guides/core-blocks/core-blocks-text/)
**API Version:** [3](/block-editor/reference-guides/block-api/block-api-versions/)
**Block Type:** [Static](/block-editor/getting-started/fundamentals/static-dynamic-rendering/) (saved in post content)

> Give quoted text visual emphasis. "In quoting others, we cite ourselves." — Julio Cortázar

**Keywords:** `blockquote`, `cite`

## Attributes

_Defined via the [`attributes`](/block-editor/reference-guides/block-api/block-attributes/) property in block.json._

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|---------|-------------|
| `value` | `string` | `""` | Source: `html`. Selector: `blockquote`. Role: `content` |
| `citation` | `rich-text` | — | Source: `rich-text`. Selector: `cite`. Role: `content` |
| `textAlign` | `string` | — | — |

## Block Markup

This is a [**static block**](/block-editor/getting-started/fundamentals/static-dynamic-rendering/). The markup is saved directly in the post content.

```html
<!-- wp:quote {"value":""} -->
<!-- Content... -->
<!-- /wp:quote -->
```
